featured.name: Scenr.io
featured.summary: Hiring for infrastructure roles by dropping the candidate into a simulated real incident and measuring how they debug it.
featured.why: At Fampay I ran release engineering for 100 engineers across 180 repositories, and watched us hire infrastructure people on LeetCode scores that told us nothing about how they behave when production is down.
what: Built the product and sold it myself: more than 100 prospect conversations, closing Scaler, Fampay and ArcFront.
Customers used it to hire a Head of Infra, SDE 2s, database administrators and security engineers.
featured.outcome: Hiring for those roles went from weeks to days. Raised angel funding and received acquisition offers.
featured.note: Halfway through, customers asked to run AI agents through the same incidents. That is how I got into agent evaluation.

featured.name: RAS: Release Any System
featured.summary: Release automation for teams that run on bare metal and VMs.
featured.why: Kubernetes already has good GitOps tools. Self-managed servers have no standard release process, and that is where one platform engineer is stretched thinnest.
what: Sets up CI, progressive delivery, health checks, load tests during the release, and rollback.
One Go binary with no database. Every event goes to a hash-chained ledger, and AI agents act only through scoped, expiring grants.
Run against more than 100 open source repositories. The largest system deployed with it is Gitea.
featured.limit: All of that is in my own lab. No outside team runs it in production yet.

featured.name: CausalCircuit: AI SRE
featured.summary: An on-call agent that works out which fault caused which symptom during an incident, and research into why AI SRE agents that know the answer still fail to find it.
what: Connects to the infrastructure tools, collects telemetry and logs, and traces each symptom back to the fault behind it.
Every action runs under tightly scoped permissions.
The research, Knowing But Not Looking, tests whether small, targeted weight edits repair investigation failures without retraining.
featured.limit: Runs only in my lab so far, and the results are not published yet.
